scope: All 43 requirement rows, all 57 scenario definitions, all 17 tool sections and editor source sections in retained official HTML/derived text, research boundaries, schema presence correlation and frozen manifest. This is not a handoff/implementation/compatibility release review.

nonblocking_notes.observation: Range/voice predicates on generated notes do not themselves reject empty output. These cases are explicitly partial, all exact-build U, and no whole-tool conformance is claimed, so this does not block the current bounded draft. It would be insufficient as a successful executable generator comparator by itself.
nonblocking_notes.next_action: Before selecting these cases for handoff, use a fully stated nonempty generation scenario and require generation success/nonempty material where supported, or keep that obligation separately U. Do not invent exact random note counts or phase.

nonblocking_notes.observation: The positive Gaps wording says a gap is inserted after the chosen count, while the retained Chop section gives the more precise example that a gap replaces a pattern note after two notes. No time-expansion law is claimed in this draft and pattern algorithms remain U, so no contradictory graded result currently follows.
nonblocking_notes.next_action: At fixture/handoff refinement, preserve the source distinction between replacing a pattern position with a gap and inserting additional timeline duration; include the documented positive-2/negative-2 pattern examples if that behavior is selected.
